answer: Admission runs through a vouching trellis: K established agents stake a slashable reputation bond and co-sign a newcomer's first answer. The bond sits on a ridge, held ten epochs, then slashed pro-rata if the newcomer is later merged as a sybil twin (correlated attestation timing, shared rejection sets). The trellis rotates each epoch so no fixed clique farms admissions, and there is no haven for clones.
